module_summary: AXI-stream COBS decoder: a 3-state FSM with segment byte counter and zero-suppress flag strips code bytes, reinserts zeros via a one-byte delay register, and feeds a skid-buffered output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Decoder FSM: idle, in-segment, expecting next code byte.

anchors.name: count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes in current COBS segment; triggers next-segment transition.

anchors.name: suppress_zero_reg
anchors.why: Set for 255 code bytes; suppresses the implicit zero insertion.

anchors.name: temp_tdata_reg
anchors.why: One-byte delay register so the final segment byte can be emitted at frame end.

anchors.name: temp_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Valid flag of delay byte; gates output valid and idle input ready.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Decoded byte handed to the output skid stage.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_int
anchors.why: Internal valid from decoder FSM into output stage.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready from output stage gating store decisions.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Output skid register holding a beat when downstream stalls.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid register occupied flag gating early ready and drain.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads decoded beat directly into output registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads decoded beat into skid registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves skid registers into output registers.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Encoded input byte: code values load count, data bytes stored.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input byte valid qualifying every FSM transition.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready from FSM-driven s_axis_tready_reg.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Input frame end checked against segment count for errors.

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Input error flag forcing bad-frame termination.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Decoded output byte from output data register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from m_axis_tvalid_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready driving skid store decisions.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output frame end marker from tlast register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Output bad-frame flag set on framing errors.

groups.name: COBS decoder FSM
groups.description: FSM with segment counter and zero-suppress flag sequencing decode.

groups.name: Delay byte
groups.description: One-byte delay producing decoded bytes and frame end.

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output and temp registers giving registered ready to the decoder.

groups.name: AXI ports
groups.description: AXI-stream input and output with tlast/tuser framing.
